name: VoiceStudio | Open-Source ElevenLabs Alternative, Voice Cloning & TTS
description: Voice cloning, text-to-speech, dubbing and transcription in your browser
card_desc: VoiceStudio: the open-source ElevenLabs alternative. Clone voices, generate speech in 600+ languages, dub videos and transcribe audio from a web UI, with an OpenAI-compatible speech API.
